name: Outbound RDP Connections Over Non-Standard Tools
description:
Detects Non-Standard tools initiating a connection over port 3389 indicating possible lateral movement.
An initial baseline is required before using this utility to exclude third party RDP tooling that you might use.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (destination.port:3389 AND network.direction:true) AND (NOT (process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\mstsc.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\mstsc.exe))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\dns.exe AND source.port:53 AND network.transport:udp) OR (process.executable:(*\\Avast\ Software\\Avast\\AvastSvc.exe OR *\\Avast\\AvastSvc.exe)) OR process.executable:*\\RDCMan.exe OR process.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe OR (process.executable:(*\\FSAssessment.exe OR *\\FSDiscovery.exe OR *\\MobaRTE.exe OR *\\mRemote.exe OR *\\mRemoteNG.exe OR *\\Passwordstate.exe OR *\\RemoteDesktopManager.exe OR *\\RemoteDesktopManager64.exe OR *\\RemoteDesktopManagerFree.exe OR *\\RSSensor.exe OR *\\RTS2App.exe OR *\\RTSApp.exe OR *\\spiceworks\-finder.exe OR *\\Terminals.exe OR *\\ws_TunnelService.exe)) OR (process.executable:(*\\thor.exe OR *\\thor64.exe)) OR process.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\SplunkUniversalForwarder\\bin\\* OR process.executable:*\\Ranger\\SentinelRanger.exe OR process.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\TSplus\\Java\\bin\\HTML5service.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\TSplus\\Java\\bin\\HTML5service.exe)) OR (NOT _exists_:process.executable) OR process.executable:"" OR process.executable:\<unknown\ process\>))
